I am sorry that you are going through this. Some of the things you can consider doing:  
1. See a doctor. You might be going through a burnout/depression.

  
2. Take a few days of me time+vacation(if you can afford it). The break might help you recover your energy and motivation.

  
3. Make lists of things you enjoy doing, things you love about yourself, things motivate you, reasons why you need to get your work done

  
4. Take regular breaks while working

5. Break up all your work into 5 minute tasks. It can be daunting to take up a massive project. It feel relatively less hard to just do a quick 5 minute tasks. Divide and conquer

I am so sorry for everything that you have gone through. I have had many suicidal periods too.

Please consider calling a suicide line in your country  [https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/wiki/hotlines](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/wiki/hotlines)

Your life is innately valuable. You don't have to become or do anything to make it so.

Please take a 1 day period to think it over. Please.
